howItWorksPage.companyStep2Desc: Describe the role, required skills, and ideal candidate. Our AI helps optimize your listing.

howItWorksPage.companyStep4Desc: Watch AI interview recordings, review scores, and make your hiring decision with confidence.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Scale as you grow. No hidden fees.

pricing.proDesc: For growing companies with active hiring needs
pricing.enterpriseDesc: For large organizations with complex hiring needs
pricing.faq1Q: Can I try before I commit?
pricing.faq1A: Absolutely! Our Starter plan is free forever. You can post up to 3 jobs and experience AI matching with no commitment.
pricing.faq2Q: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faq2A: We accept all major credit cards, bank transfers, and regional payment methods including Apple Pay and Mada.
pricing.faq3A: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
pricing.faq4A: Yes! In addition to subscriptions, we offer a pay-per-hire model. Contact our sales team for pricing details.
